content:
The `.editorconfig` is created. Here's the rationale based on the existing files: | Setting | Value | Why | |---|---|---| | `root = true` | — | Stops at this file, no parent `.editorconfig` is considered. | | `end_of_line = lf` | `lf` | All existing files use Unix-style `\n` line endings (shown by `cat -A`). | | `charset = utf-8` | `utf-8` | All files are US-ASCII (a UTF-8 subset), no BOM. | | `trim_trailing_whitespace = true` | `true` | No trailing whitespace exists in any file. | | `insert_final_newline = true` | `true` | Every file ends with a newline character (the last `$` from `cat -A`). | | `indent_style = space` | `space` | Both Python (`scripts/new_migration.py`) and SQL (`migrations/0001_create_users.sql`) use spaces, not tabs. | | `indent_size = 4` | `4` | Python uses 4-space indentation; SQL column definitions also use 4 spaces. | The **`[*.md]` override** sets `trim_trailing_whitespace = false` because trailing spaces have semantic meaning in Markdown (two trailing spaces produce a `
` line break), and a blanket `true` on markdown can inadvertently strip deliberate hard breaks.
